data.gender_notes: Dhenuka is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhenuka is a Sanskrit name that means 'cow' or 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, cows are considered sacred and symbolize wealth, nourishment, and abundance. The name is also derived from the goddess Dhenu, who is the goddess of cows and prosperity. The name Dhenuka carries the meaning “Cow, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhenuka usually hope their child will grow to embody cow, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhenuka belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cow, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhenuka total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
